sources.title: GitHub - RajMay/OCR_Qwen2_VL
sources.snippet: OCR Web Application using Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct This project is a web-based Optical Character Recognition (OCR) tool that uses the Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct model for extracting text from images. The web interface is built using Streamlit, and the model is processed via the Hugging Face transformers library.

sources.title: Qwen2-VL-OCR-2B-Instruct [ VL / OCR ] - Models
sources.snippet: The Qwen2-VL-OCR-2B-Instruct model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen/Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, tailored for tasks that involve Optical Character Recognition (OCR), image-to-text conversion, and math problem solving with LaTeX formatting.
